# 三相 LCC 电容充电电源 AOC 策略资料包（最终版）

> 50 V → 800 V 三相 Δ/Y LCC 谐振电容充电电源的 AOC（adaptive optimization charging）策略梳理。两层内容：Qin 等 2023 IEEE JESTPE 论文的 AOC 方法；本项目 2026-10-20 定稿、2026-10-24 验证的 59 节点离线 `fs(Vo)` 查表轨迹。含公式、关键数、模型层级、可写/不可写边界与论文写作骨架。无硬件实验；原论文 PDF 与论文原图不随仓库分发。

Canonical site: https://sososoamazing.github.io/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/
Repository: https://github.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy

## Start here

- [ONE_PAGE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/main/ONE_PAGE.md): 一页式总览；给 LLM 的最佳单 URL。
- [README.md](https://github.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/blob/main/README.md): 仓库入口、30 秒结论、GPT 使用说明。
- [docs/00_overview.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/main/docs/00_overview.md): 范围、版本政策、时间线。
- [docs/05_claims_and_boundaries.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/main/docs/05_claims_and_boundaries.md): claim–evidence 对照、禁用表述。

## Literature (Qin 2023)

- [docs/01_paper_AOC_digest.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/main/docs/01_paper_AOC_digest.md): 题录、研究问题、CRC-FHA、三条约束、三阶段控制、2174 W 实验、边界。
- [docs/02_equations.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/main/docs/02_equations.md): 式 (2)(11)–(20) 的转写、符号表、适用域、不可移植项。

- [docs/03_project_AOC_final.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/main/docs/03_project_AOC_final.md): 59 节点轨迹的优化模型、构造、形态、控制实现、结果、缺口。

- [data/aoc_59_nodes.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/main/data/aoc_59_nodes.csv): 最终 59 节点表。

- [docs/07_sources.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sososoamazing/lcc-aoc-charging-strategy/main/docs/07_sources.md): 来源、哈希、版本关系、未随包文件。

## Key numbers (final version only)

- Final table: 59 nodes, 20–800 V, 241.5905–299.2573 kHz, 0–20 V at 300 kHz.
- Phase peak max 13.99995 A; commutation-current proxy min 1.43999 A (threshold 1.40019 A); Io 1.85547→0.79996 A.
- Quasi-static 20→800 V: 2.089438 ms. M1 dynamic t800: 2.153487 ms. Same-model old 21-node table: 2.596206 ms (−17.05%).
- 20-point accuracy: HOGA-H49 Io MAPE 0.00566%, RMS 0.00391%, peak 0.0270%, NRMSE 0.0307%.
- M2 (100 ns dead time, Coss, Cj) exists only for the old 21-node table: 2.572428 ms, 14.279921 A, 4 startup residual failures. Do not mix with M1.

## For ChatGPT / web agents

Use `ONE_PAGE.md` plus `docs/06_writing_guide.md` first. Ask for an outline and a number list before prose. Enforce: distinguish literature AOC (online current loop) from this project's offline lookup trajectory; do not claim current PI, hardware ZVS, global optimum, efficiency gain, or a three-phase speedup percentage. Cite Qin 2023 with DOI 10.1109/JESTPE.2023.3301738.
